title: Pan-Seared Slovakian Black Pudding with Vividly Fresh Peppery Greens
description: A hearty French-inspired dish featuring crispy Slovakian black pudding, paired with peppery greens and a hint of papillote.
instructions: Preheat a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Add butter and let it melt.
Add black pudding slices and cook for 3-4 minutes on each side, until crispy.
Add peppery greens to the pan and cook until wilted.
Season with thyme, parsley, salt, and pepper.
Wrap the pan with papillote and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until heated through.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
